name: Blue Sea 2340 busbar with one drilled 3/8 hole (positive, red cover), battery-terminal mount

cutout.note: cover cut by hand to clear the adapter: round opening, full cover height, SAE adapter hex base (0.750 in AF, 0.866 in across corners) + 1/16 in clearance

edge_wall.note: Edge wall = hole centre to nearest plate edge minus hole radius, from the model dims (plate width 1.0 in is an estimate). Side edge: 0.047 in (1.2 mm). Block-end edge: hole centre 0.20 in from the end minus radius 0.203 = -0.003 in (negative = hole breaks out of the end if the plate ends at the screw-block end; the real end distance is not dimensioned). Rule: safe only if hole centre to edge >= 0.3 in; otherwise 5/16.

mounts.note: hole centre on bottom face of tab; local -X runs from the hole toward the screw block; yaw about Y (right-handed, as three.js rotation.y) = rotation about the stud axis: +90 deg points the body at +Z (battery front/label side, default), -90 at -Z (back edge); yaw_step_deg = allowed rotation increment
top of the tab on the stud axis; the nut sits here

notes: Source: Blue Sea Systems customer drawing PN 2340 (dimensioned drawing on bluesea.com). Cover height, joggle offset and copper thickness are not dimensioned: measured from sheet 2 side view proportions (estimates). Drawing says #8-32 screws; the Amazon listing title says 10-24; drawing used. Plain shapes, no logos. Variant: the end-most #8-32 screw (t3) is removed and its hole drilled to 13/32 for a 3/8-16 stud. Bar size unchanged. Coverless (cover cannot fit over the stud). See dims.drill.edge_wall.

cover.label: Cover
cover.note: cover cut by hand to clear the adapter (round opening around bar_hole). Cover stays on by default, like the plain 2340.

connections.note: tab on the battery stud; 100 A is the Blue Sea rating for the whole busbar
per-screw rating is an estimate (100 A / 4)
per-screw rating is an estimate (100 A / 4)
per-screw rating is an estimate (100 A / 4)

accepts.note: 13/32 hole drilled out of the end-most #8-32 screw position (t3); takes a 3/8-16 stud with a nut under and over the plate (stud-38-16)
